title: Reliability Initiative Commitment Accelerator and Scorecard
creator: Ava Mitchell
description:
Create an initiative-level scorecard and an automated 'commitment accelerator' flow that helps product and platform teams make defensible error-budget commitments and reallocation proposals. The goal is to reduce manual coordination time during quarters by surfacing a standardized health metric, suggested tranche adjustments, and a clear set of gating rules for rollouts. This ticket covers the PM product requirements, telemetry contract with SRE, Console UX wires, and acceptance criteria for the MVP. Key capabilities:

- Initiative scorecard: composite metric combining SLI attainment, burn rate, customer impact, and release velocity.
- Commitment accelerator: runs simulations of proposed tranche adjustments and outputs recommended actions (hold, reduce rollout %, allow burst, request mitigation) with rationale.
- Auto-proposals: generate a changelog PR + recommended rollback/throttle policies that can be attached to a rollout.
- Console integration: new initiative view with trend sparkline, current error budget runway, and one-click 'propose reallocation' flow for initiative owners.
- Telemetry & API: standard SLI payload spec, normalized burn-rate window, and backfill rules for heterogeneous services (hosted/dedicated/private).

This work is cross-functional: PM (this ticket), SRE (telemetry + gating rules), Console UX/Design (wires + microcopy), and Engineering (backend aggregator and automation runner).
acceptance_criteria: Scorecard displays composite health (0-100) and explains contribution from SLI attainment, burn rate, and customer impact.
Commitment accelerator can simulate at least three reallocation scenarios and present costs/expected SLI impact.
Console flow generates a recommended rollback/throttle policy that can be attached to a rollout in Console.
Telemetry contract documented in Confluence and signed off by SRE leads.
Automated proposal produces a GitHub PR template (linkable) and a human-readable rationale note.
On-call runbook references for emergency reclaims are linked from the scorecard when customer_impact is high.

updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff — aligned on composite score components: SLI attainment (50%), burn-rate trend (30%), customer impact (10%), rollout velocity (10%). Action: SRE to provide sample SLI streams for three services.
2026-02-18: Telemetry contract v0.2 posted (Confluence link in PRD). SRE flagged missing normalized window for mixed deployments (dedicated/private). Added backfill policy item.
2026-02-25: Design review — wires updated to include 'Why this recommendation?' tooltip and drilldown to raw SLI series. UX asked for a compact summary card for Slack notifications.

2026-03-03: Prototype aggregator completed by Eng (branch: feat/initiative-scorecard). Composite computation validated against historical quarter data — correlates with prior manual assessments in 8/10 cases.

2026-03-06: Risk identified — current metrics pipeline drops events for low-volume private deployments. Mitigation: fallback to 7-day rolling median and mark score as 'partial' until data backfill completes.
2026-03-10: SRE review meeting — accepted gating rules for candidate proposals: must not increase burn-rate > 15% vs baseline and must keep projected SLI attainment > target-0.2%.
2026-03-12: Decided to ship MVP without auto-apply of proposals (human-in-loop). Added a follow-up ticket for 'auto-apply with approvals' guarded by security review.
